settings.slap_policy: Binary and weighted, explicit H, heavy symmetry breaking, isolated upstream element balancing, uncut plus all source edges
settings.reference_policy: Full heavy mapping including unmatched atoms modulo chemical endpoint symmetry; decoded audit separately uses exact indices

resources.resource_sampling_note: Peak memory and failed CPU use process-tree samples; short unsampled tasks do not establish zero use.

timing_note: One timed trial per reaction. Sum both directions per reaction. Search includes preparation, matching and reduction. IO, publication, audit bookkeeping and reference checks are separate. The matching elapsed span includes drained continuations and waiting.
